result.reason: The clause retains mutuality, the required carve-outs, and the payment-obligation treatment, and its 12-month paid-and-payable limb would substantially satisfy the fallback. However, the unresolved “USD [—]” placeholder makes the cap indeterminate, so the rendered language does not establish either the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor or a definite fallback cap. It also omits the preferred mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, adds an unexplained reference to Section 21.4, duplicates the Section 21.1 number, and narrows the fee base to the “applicable Order Form.” The margin comment cannot cure these operative-language defects and requests a Section 1.5 amendment that was not made.
